n8d7fc5cdf3.headline: Prague airport breaks record. Handled over 15 million passengers - Novinky
n8d7fc5cdf3.summary: Václav Havel Airport Prague surpassed 15 million passengers handled, the highest in its 80-year history, breaking last year's record of 13 million.
n8d7fc5cdf3.why: Passenger traffic growth reflects economic activity and tourism trends, impacting airport revenues and related sectors.
